entries.summary: commons 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT DELETES com.inttra.mercury.messaging.* — invalidates the 2026-06-30 initial design; 13 files change, not 4
entries.detail:
Verified by diffing jars in ~/.m2: commons-1.R.01.023.jar contains com/inttra/mercury/messaging/{sqs,sns,logging,model,config,util}; commons-1.0.28-SNAPSHOT.jar contains ZERO entries under com/inttra/mercury/messaging/. The 2026-06-30 initial design assumed commons would keep that API and just re-back it with v2 ("bump commons and verify") — that is WRONG.

Blast radius: 13 of 41 java files (7 main + 6 test). 4 files import v1 com.amazonaws.*; 11 files import the removed commons messaging.*.

Verified replacement mapping (all present in cloud-sdk-api/cloud-sdk-aws 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT):
  messaging.sqs.SQSClient (x5)        -> cloudsdk.messaging.api.MessagingClient<String>  (receiveMessages(url,max,wait) default method matches old receiveMessage arg-for-arg)
  messaging.sns.SNSClient (x2)        -> cloudsdk.notification.api.NotificationService
  messaging.logging.SNSEventPublisher -> cloudsdk.notification.workflow.SnsEventPublisher  (NOTE casing SNS->Sns)
  messaging.logging.EventPublisher    -> cloudsdk.notification.workflow.EventPublisher
  messaging.logging.EventLogger       -> cloudsdk.notification.workflow.EventLogger
  messaging.logging.EventGenerator    -> cloudsdk.notification.workflow.EventGenerator
  messaging.logging.ErrorHelper       -> cloudsdk.notification.annotation.ErrorHelper   (package moves)
  messaging.model.Annotations         -> cloudsdk.notification.annotation.Annotations
  messaging.model.MetaData (x3)       -> cloudsdk.notification.workflow.MetaData
  messaging.model.Event (x2)          -> cloudsdk.notification.workflow.Event
  messaging.util.RandomGenerator (x3) -> cloudsdk.notification.util.RandomGenerator
  messaging.config.SQSModule/SNSModule-> NO REPLACEMENT: become local @Provides in BookingCargoScreenApplicationInjector
  messaging.config.AwsRetryCondition  -> NO REPLACEMENT: folded into a v2 RetryStrategy predicate

Same problem ION-16380 solved for watermill-publisher, so the pattern is proven rather than novel.

entries.summary: HIGH RISK: cloud-sdk QueueMessage is immutable but SqsMessageHandler mutates attributes for DO_NOT_DELETE / DO_NO_SEND_TO_DLQ — naive retype fails SILENTLY
entries.detail:
javap confirms cloud-sdk QueueMessage<T> is read-only: getMessageId(), getReceiptHandle(), getPayload(), getAttributes(), getSentTimestamp(). There is NO setAttributes, and getAttributes() may return an immutable map.

SqsMessageHandler implements two control flags by MUTATING the v1 Message's attribute map:
  setDoNotDelete(m)      -> attributes.put(DO_NOT_DELETE_KEY, "true");  m.setAttributes(attributes)
  setDoNoSendToDlqKey(m) -> attributes.put(DO_NO_SEND_TO_DLQ_KEY,"true"); m.setAttributes(attributes)
then reads them back in taskExceptionHandler (skip DLQ) and taskFinallyHandler (skip delete).

A mechanical Message -> QueueMessage<String> retype COMPILES CLEANLY and then silently drops the flags, so a message that should be left on the queue gets DELETED. This is the single most dangerous item in the ticket.

RESOLUTION (design decision 2): add a module-local mutable adapter
  processor/sqs/CargoScreenQueueMessage implements QueueMessage<String>
    - delegates getMessageId/getReceiptHandle/getPayload/getSentTimestamp
    - holds a MUTABLE copy of attributes seeded from the delegate
    - exposes putAttribute(k,v)
SqsMessageHandler.getMessages() wraps each received message. Mirrors the SqsQueueMessage adapter ION-16380 added to watermill-commons.

MANDATORY TEST: assert end-to-end that DO_NOT_DELETE suppresses deleteMessage and DO_NO_SEND_TO_DLQ suppresses the DLQ send, through the adapter. Without it this parity rots invisibly.

entries.summary: S3 tuning preserved exactly (user-confirmed); AwsRetryCondition decompiled = retry-everything, NOT a throttle/5xx predicate — v2 standard strategy would be a silent behaviour change
entries.detail:
USER DECISION: preserve the v1 S3 client tuning exactly rather than using createDefaultS3Client().

v1 (BookingCargoScreenApplicationInjector.bindS3):
  RetryPolicy(new AwsRetryCondition(), new PredefinedBackoffStrategies.FullJitterBackoffStrategy(500,5000), 3, false)
  ClientConfiguration.withMaxErrorRetry(3).withRetryPolicy(rp).withConnectionTimeout(1000).withSocketTimeout(5000).withMaxConnections(50)
  (withClientExecutionTimeout is COMMENTED OUT in source — leave unset)

CAPABILITY VERIFIED via javap on the real 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT jars:
  StorageClientFactory.createS3Client(AwsStorageConfig)                                  EXISTS
  BaseAwsConfig.BaseAwsConfigBuilder: retryStrategy(RetryStrategy), httpClient(AwsHttpClientWrapper),
      region(AwsRegionWrapper), credentialsProvider(AwsCredentialsProviderWrapper),
      clientExecutionTimeout(Duration), threadPoolSize(int)
  AwsHttpClientWrapper.ofSync(Object) accepts a pre-built v2 ApacheHttpClient (where the 3 timeouts + pool live)
  RetryStrategy.Builder: retryOnException(Predicate<Throwable>), maxAttempts(int), backoffStrategy(BackoffStrategy)
  BackoffStrategy.exponentialDelay(base,max) is the FULL-JITTER variant (halfJitter / withoutJitter are the others)

KEY FINDING — AwsRetryCondition decompiled from commons-1.R.01.023.jar:
  public boolean shouldRetry(req, ex, attempt) { log.warn("Failed calling %s, attempt #%s", ...); return true; }
  Bytecode ends iconst_1 / ireturn => RETRIES EVERYTHING UNCONDITIONALLY.
This INVERTS the earlier assumption. It is not an approximation of the standard throttle/5xx predicate, so falling
back to v2's standard predicate would silently STOP retrying 404 NoSuchKey / 403 that are retried 3x today.

FAITHFUL v2 EQUIVALENT (implement this):
  StandardRetryStrategy.builder()
      .maxAttempts(4)                                                            // 1 initial + 3 retries == withMaxErrorRetry(3)
      .backoffStrategy(BackoffStrategy.exponentialDelay(Duration.ofMillis(500), Duration.ofMillis(5000)))
      .retryOnException(t -> { log.warn("Failed calling S3, retrying", t); return true; })   // == AwsRetryCondition
      .build()
  + AwsHttpClientWrapper.ofSync(ApacheHttpClient.builder()
       .connectionTimeout(Duration.ofMillis(1000)).socketTimeout(Duration.ofMillis(5000)).maxConnections(50).build())

MANDATORY TEST: assert maxAttempts, backoff type, the 3 timeouts / pool size, and that the predicate returns true for a
NON-retryable exception. Unasserted tuning silently reverts to defaults.
